sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored - GitHub
sources.snippet: Official Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M (~16.8 GB) + a harvested uncensored SYSTEM pack. GitHub cannot host the weights. Download the GGUF below, or pull the Ollama tag — this repo bakes the residual so ollama run stays uncensored.

sources.title: Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated launches as an uncensored AI model for free
sources.snippet: The model is based on Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, but this version is explicitly presented as an uncensored release. According to the card, the first 15 layers were left unablated, while MTP and the visual part were left unchanged, so the project did not rewrite the entire system at once.

sources.title: How to Run Qwen 3.8 in Production: API, Self-Hosted 27B, or Both (2026)
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.8 gives production teams both halves: a frontier API flagship and an Apache 2.0 27B that serves from one GPU. How to consume the API defensively, size the self-hosted tier, and where the cost crossover actually sits.
